title: A VISION OF THE PAST
author: Bipin Patsani
text:
I see schools of thought
Dividing in the process
Of creating a culture
In India as in the world
And the Vedic Brahmins
In their spiritual concern
Uncomfortable with
The scientific artisans
Materialism of the south
Using Ram as an instrument
Who was to bridge the gap
As was Mandara Parvata
To churn the ocean of wisdom
In which each end was to play
Its component part.

I see Drona, Shakuni and Krishna
Using Kaurav Kin
To reach their specific goals.
And warriors,
In spite of their historic role
Would not rise above the Ant-hill.

While gods would be made
To annihilate evil,
Their permissiveness
Would take new forms
To gather around storms
Putting thus in turmoil
Each contemporary unit;
Class war being a necessary evil
Like the war of minds,
For life is a struggle against sluggishness
And civilization a bi-product of clash
As are grains, brains or an offspring

Coming out of sport.
